title: The hash and mgf1Hash options of RSA-PSS key generation have been removed
summary: Node.js removed the hash and mgf1Hash options of RSA-PSS key generation (DEP0154: documentation-only since v16.10.0, runtime deprecation since v20.0.0, end-of-life since v25.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of the hash and mgf1Hash options of RSA-PSS key generation with the hashAlgorithm and mgf1HashAlgorithm options.

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
